raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 was re-delivered at 05:00, so 316 POSTED transactions from 2026-01-18 are loaded twice. The silver step has no de-duplication, which inflates silver and every gold table built from it. Keeping one row per txn_id, the earliest-ingested, restores the 2026-01-18 count to about the 14-day median.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts, batch_id) = 1;"}}
